head: b5837e80a4550fc35165d0013a8ef0f27ccb4c8f
formal_acceptance_note: All technical/functional completion criteria (task section 23) are met; no human product-owner sign-off has occurred in this session.

root_cause_of_pre_a3_neutral_unclassifie.conflation: claim-level direction (positive/negative/neutral/unknown) used as a proxy for 'unclassified', with no access to matched_alpha/evidence_stance/duplicate-group fields at all
root_cause_of_pre_a3_neutral_unclassifie.concrete_failure_example: a direction=neutral claim with a real matched_alpha, a supports_alpha B1 stance, and ticker-specific text was always shown as 'neutral and unclassified'

universe_definition.unclassified_iff: at least one of the 5 canonical reasons applies (evaluated from existing signals only); zero reasons => fully classified => excluded from the artifact entirely

reason_signals.generic_background: match.matched_evidence_stance in {neutral_background, mentions_alpha}, only when matched_alpha is present
reason_signals.duplicate_supporting_text: claim is a non-representative member_claim_ids entry of an evidence_facts.json group whose supporting_alpha_ids includes the claim's own matched_alpha
reason_signals.no_ticker_specific_evidence: activation_scorer_v2._is_ticker_specific(match, ticker, (), {}) is False, only when matched_alpha is present -- same function/call-convention B2's conflict_admissibility.py already uses

universe_definition.unresolved_escape_hatch: fires only when matched_alpha is present and matched_evidence_stance is neither a known classified value (supports_alpha/opposes_alpha/supports_counter_alpha) nor a known background value (neutral_background/mentions_alpha) -- a genuine data anomaly, never guessed into one of the 5

low_confidence_rejected_candidate_signal.reason_rejected: different concept (confidence in the Evidence Stance classification itself, not in the claim's own assertion); every CONFIDENCE_LOW branch already produces a neutral_background/mentions_alpha stance, so it would never win primary under the frozen priority order anyway; reusing it would repeat the confidence/relevance conflation PD-012 already forbids for match scores

top_20_ordering.missing_confidence_or_claim_index: sorts after present values, never guessed as 0/1
top_20_ordering.display_rank_scope: assigned over the entire unclassified universe; the artifact's findings list is never truncated -- only the API/UI layer slices [:display_limit]

artifact_manifest_api_run_audit_consiste.download_route: existing generic GET /api/research/{run_id}/artifacts/{artifact_name} -- no new route built; validate_run_id_for_path/validate_artifact_filename boundary reused unchanged
artifact_manifest_api_run_audit_consiste.incompatible_schema_version_handling: treated identically to artifact-absent by both build_run_audit_payload and build_research_response

not_touched: comqutor_alpha/graph_engine/activation_scorer_v2.py (scoring logic; only the existing _is_ticker_specific helper is imported)

direction_neutral_but_valid_never_wrongl.explanation: both claims genuinely lack ticker-specific text in their own sentence (macro/valuation commentary never naming NVDA); no_ticker_specific_evidence correctly still applies independent of direction/stance

frontend_visual_verification.method: real backend (fresh process, port 8010) + real Vite dev server (port 5190) + Playwright, against the real NVDA run
frontend_visual_verification.db_seed_technique: one research_runs row inserted directly from the run's own metadata.json (status=completed) so the polling endpoint would serve an already-completed offline run

forbidden_language_scan.explanation: all matches are either false positives against ordinary English (holding/threshold/'expectations hold'), verbatim quoted analyst/social-sentiment claim text displayed for traceability (a pre-existing, cross-panel property, not introduced by or in scope for A3), or COMQUTOR's own disclaimer sentence ('...does not predict outcomes, guarantee profit...') being caught by the crude phrase match

known_pre_existing_failures.cause: frozen SHA-256 baseline of alpha_mapper.py/week2_llm.py predates B1's own intentional Evidence Stance changes to those files; baseline never updated
NVDA_MAIN_CONFLICT_NOT_ARBITRATED -- demo/seed golden fixture predates B2's stricter Conflict Evidence Admissibility gate
NVDA_MAIN_CONFLICT_NOT_ARBITRATED -- same root cause as above

known_follow_up_not_expanded_into_a3_sco: a claim that is direction-neutral/unknown AND fully classified (0 A3 reasons) has no dedicated display slot on the Research Run page (it was never shown by the Positive/Negative panels before A3 either); adding one would require either shipping the full unclassified-claim-id set to the client on every poll (explicitly disallowed) or a new backend concept outside A3's mandate
